name: WLAN Monitor
description: See who is on your Wi-Fi from the top bar: every device with a type icon and plain-language status, your own names, new-device alerts, groups by platform, type or Wi-Fi band, a network map, FRITZ!Box mesh details and VPN detection that explains when a VPN blocks your home network. Automatic subnet sweeps only on networks you trust (or when you click Rescan). Left click opens the panel, right click rescans. Needs python3.
